mapper.sql: FROM edu_consume c JOIN edu_contract ct ON ct.id = c.contract_id JOIN edu_teacher t ON t.id = c.teacher_id JOIN edu_student s ON s.id = c.student_id JOIN edu_course co ON co.id = c.course_id WHERE c.canceled = 0 AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.audit_status = 1 AND (#{tenantId} IS NULL OR c.tenant_id = #{tenantId}) AND c.create_time >= CONCAT(#{begin},' 00:00:00') AND c.create_time <= CONCAT(#{end},' 23:59:59') AND c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.course_id = #{courseId} AND c.class_type = #{classType}
ROUND(CASE WHEN c.class_type = 1 THEN IFNULL(t.rate_one2one,0) ELSE IFNULL(t.rate_class,0) END * c.hours, 2)
mapper.select:
SELECT c.consume_no AS consumeNo, DATE(c.create_time) AS consumeDate, s.name AS studentName, co.name AS courseName, c.class_type AS classType, t.name AS teacherName, c.hours AS hours, ROUND(ct.unit_price * c.hours, 2) AS revenue, AS teacherCost, ROUND(ct.unit_price * c.hours - , 2) AS profit, CASE WHEN ct.unit_price * c.hours > 0 THEN ROUND( / (ct.unit_price * c.hours) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS costRatio, ct.contract_no AS contractNo
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT co.name AS name
SELECT t.name AS name
,SUM(c.hours) AS totalHours, ROUND(SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours), 2) AS totalRevenue, ROUND(SUM(), 2) AS totalCost, ROUND(SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours) - SUM(), 2) AS totalProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM() / SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS avgCostRatio
GROUP BY co.id, co.name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC
GROUP BY t.id, t.name ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(c.hours), 0) AS totalHours, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours), 2), 0) AS totalRevenue, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(), 2), 0) AS totalCost, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours) - SUM(), 2), 0) AS totalProfit, CASE WHEN SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours) > 0 THEN ROUND(SUM() / SUM(ct.unit_price * c.hours) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS costRatio
